story:
Bridges Lighting Pros is the lighting arm of Bridges Elite Landscapes, a North Georgia landscaping company working out of Loganville. That order matters. We did not start as a lighting franchise looking for yards to sell into — we spent years building the beds, walls, walkways and planting in these properties, and lighting them is the same job carried on after dark.

It turns out that background is most of the skill. Knowing which tree in a front yard carries an uplight and which one just looks like a floodlit tree, where a path fixture stops guiding people and starts glaring at them, how a roofline is actually read from the street rather than from a ladder — none of that comes out of a product catalogue. It comes from having stood in a lot of front yards.

So we do the whole range on one system. Permanent architectural lighting that goes up once and stays up. Landscape, path and outdoor living lighting for the parts of the yard people actually sit in. Café and patio lighting for restaurants. Weddings, receptions and events, installed around the venue's schedule and taken away afterwards. And holiday lighting on a lease program where we own the lights, maintain them, take them down in January and store them until next season — because the thing homeowners genuinely want is not to have to think about it.

We are owner-operated. The people who quote your job are the people who install it, and if something goes out you get a local number in Loganville rather than a warranty department in another state. Through the holiday season we respond to service calls within 24 hours, next business day. Installing lights is the easy half of this trade. Coming back is the half that decides whether anyone recommends you.
